book.name: Revelesin
book.title: REVELESIN God ata lom dulun weng tap ma Jon ami kukon-balala, utamsa kaata ko

content: Yesus ami sukon diim as dan fetkal duk-duu kuyak tiisa kaami sang kaata ko
Sipsip Man Yesus ayo God ami as dan fak-tiisa fet diim ata tuk-duu-lom sukon ami mutum ayo alik bam-daa kutiile, unang tunum alik abiil tikiin bom-bilip iyo duluma bom ilanin tap keliple,
nayo itami yi, Ensel fetkal iyo God ami tibi diim kulu tolbip-kup, maakup maakup ita bikul maakup uyo kuluu-kuluu-keliwa, itami.

Kemin, kamasi kaali, as dan aye, as kon aa, fuumin ami baan tebol kabaak-ali as so, gol so, kuyak-mim-daa dotu-lom ale, kulii-din God ami tiin-yaamin mepso kutiilip tiinsula, unang tunum alik ili God ami beten kamaalip. Kemin, ensel ma ali suunkup din as dan so, as kon so, uyo kuyak daala kiin-bala, ami tang ayo tangbal-kup tabasu. Kemin, tang ayo God ami mutum tem tam unu utamdala, almi unang tunum imi beten uyo weng san-kaaba. Kemin, kuluu Jon nayo utamila, Fuumin kaami ensel ali din as dan so, as kon so, kiili gol ket kuluu-lomda umi kuyak dakamin baan umi mepso kuluwu tolnala, ensel kusnum ma ata as dan so, as kon yaapkan so, ayo maso kulii-tal-ilomda kamosinim ensel ami tolba ami kola kala, kalile, kulaali

ensel ma ata as dan so, kon so, unang tunum imi beten kamaalin so, kiiyo kuluu-lomda as kuyak daalaya, kiin-taba-lom as lak tang tangbal ayo kutam daalala, God ayo tang tangbal ayo utamale, almi unang tunum imi beten uyo weng san-kaaba kala, kali ko.

Kemin, ensel ayo as dan so, as kon so, kiimi ket uyo kulii yang olti aye, mafek mafek fuu-lom God ami kukaalin kaami baan diim kuluba-lom ale, as mol uyo fokola daak ket tem unu dongnala, kulii yang dukum-kup binala tildaak tawaal diim abamnule, ayo kanolala kulu, weng yaapkan ma bakan-tabamnule, taman ayo kol-bulu, abiil tikiin ayo baabaa-kup dabaka-balale, bim ami kutaltam daa liin-bala kemu ko.
Ensel atalingkal isiik bikul o, kala fongket naan-bisip, kaata ko
Kemin, kulaa ensel fetkal iyo bikul fetkal kutal-fukubip iyo dotu-lomdip kulaata naan-tabum o, kalip ko.

Kamasi diildiil kaali, ensel maakup ma ami bikul kasiik fong kala naan-balaya, wom lap tuum tap sole, baabaa so, kiim so, kiiyo tal kabak-kabak-ke-lomdip am bokon kulaa dik-daa kulaasa ayo tildaak abamnu. Katale, tawaal alik ma kiin-abam-noma disa; tawaal iip maakup maakup ma kiin-aba-kiin-aba-kelu umi siksiilu uyo tawaal umi daam asuumano umi maakup ma uta kiin abamna. Kemin, as yakal ti tawaal kanolin tap ke balaasaal as kon wiis dik-daalin alik uyo ti kiin-tabamnu ko.

Kulaa, ensel alep ma akal almi bikul ayo naan-balala, mafek mafek ma amdu aalap dukum, disa kawu as kiinba tap ayo binalip daak yol ok kumun tem unu ko. Ayo kanolule, yol ok anung ma tiltam tulu uyo, ti fan kiim alik-daap kelu. Katale, yol wok anung alep ma kabang-ali kano kelula, kabang yaap-kup ilu ko.
Kanoluya, yol ok anung ma amdu tikiinlo kawu kulii-tildaak abamnu kabaak-ali aniing yaapkan ayo alik saak tem daalipla, sip uyo kiin-taba-lomdu alik kiin-taba disa kelule,

kuno ensel asuum ma ayo almi bikul uyo naan-buluya, wakalkan dukum as dawang bak-tam-dakaba tap uyo, abiil tikiinlo kawu dik-tam daa, umbital tawaal kala dik-daa kulaasu kalawaami tawaal tem ok umbilaak liip tem ok fak-tam-daka-bam tal-unebu kuso, tip diim kawu wok bina tal-unebu so, ami diim abamnula, wok ayo mafak-alom kok alik kelula, unang tunum iyo ok tangbal kaa dok kata ma inam-nolip dinim kelip. Uyo kanolule, wakalkan kuumi win kaali, Kok Umi Miit o, ken-umbip kemin, unang tunum yaapkan deng-kup fikip-fikip bom-bilip iyo ok kok-kup tabamnala, ita ina-lom alik saaknip. Katale, tawaal alik disa; iip maakup maakup ma tawaal kaami liip tem ok taleba so, ok tal tam tip diim kawu uneba so, iyo ti kok alik ke-lom mafak kelu, umi siksiilu kaali, bokon asuumano kaami maakup ma uta kok taba-lom mafaknu ko.

Kulaa, ensel ataling ma ayo bikul uyo naan-buluya, atan so, kayoop so, tam wakalkan so, imi atuk ayo mafaknula, am daan-yaamin kaami am anung alep ayo yaap-kup atan tik-daa-balala, am ayo falat-kup kalule, am daan-yaamin kaami am anung ma uta atan ayo kiinama disa kelu. Kemin, kutamiiwa-yaamin tap kelu. Kemin, am kutamiiwa-yaamin kaami am anung alep uyo kayoop so, wakalkan kaaso, kiin-taba-lom falala-kup kala bulula, am kutamiip ami anung maakup kaata kayoop so, wakalkan so, kiita kiin-ilom falala-kup kalolip disa ke-lomdu atin malang mafak tinilu ko.

Kanola Jon nali awon bokol ma utamila, Abiil tikiin kaptamu falala tal-uneba kala, atam weng senile, ayo dukum-kup boko-lomda: Ensel kusnum asuumano bikul naanin disa tiinbip imi bikul dakaa-mokomip uyo tawaal diim unang tunum iyo alik ti tikip maakup angtiil yol awak uyo uta-mokomip o, kalalila, kaata atin aket uluum dap-tiip-nale, aket mafak kep-na kelula, tawaal diim kasel imi olen-yim-bam kebi no, kala awon bokol ayo kanum bakaba kala, kalali weng seni no.
